name: SME medium (chemolithotrophic enrichment) (PMC10356935)
description: SME medium (chemolithotrophic enrichment) — a minimal medium extracted from Leng et al. (2023). Mapped to BiGG from the paper's stated composition.

provenance.citation: Leng et al. Identification of a deep-branching thermophilic clade sheds light on early bacterial evolution. Nature Communications (2023). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-023-39960-x. [PMC10356935]
provenance.notes: Extracted from the primary paper (snippet: an SME medium, which contained the following components (L−1): NaCl, 20.0 g; MgSO4·7H2O, 3.5 g; MgCl2·6H2O, 2.75 g; KCl, 0.325 g; KNO3, 2.0 g; MES, 4.27 g; NaBr, 50.0 mg; H3BO3, 15.0 mg; SrCl2·6H2O, 7). Component names mapped to BiGG (see mapping_confidence); presence-based bounds unless the paper gave exchange bounds; concentration_mM where units allowed. Extraction confidence: high.
provenance.verification_evidence: an SME medium, which contained the following components (L−1): NaCl, 20.0 g; MgSO4·7 H2O, 3.5 g; MgCl2·6 H2O, 2.75 g; KCl, 0.325 g; KNO3, 2.0 g; MES, 4.27 g; NaBr, 50.0 mg; H3BO3, 15.0 mg; SrCl2·6 H2O, 7.5 mg; (NH4)2SO4, 10·0 mg; KI, 0.05 mg; Na2WO2·2H2O, 0.1 mg; CaCl2·2H2O, 0.75 g; KH2PO4, 0.5 g; NiCl2·6H2O, 2.0 mg; and resazurin, 1.0 mg. The pH of the medium was adjusted to 6.0 using 1 M NaOH. A
provenance.source_identity_evidence: provenance.notes contains 'Extracted from the primary paper'

components.name: CO2

components.mapping_note: [CHEM-CO2-01] Carbon dioxide is CO2 (formula CO2, InChIKey CURLTUGMZLYLDI-UHFFFAOYSA-N). cobalt2 is the cobalt(II) cation (formula Co, InChIKey XLJKHNWPARRRJB-UHFFFAOYSA-N). The two collided because BiGG's display name for cobalt2 is "Co2+", which lower-cases to the same key as "CO2"; the element sets are disjoint (C,O vs Co). Restricted to components already on cobalt2 whose name carries a carbon-dioxide/carbonate token, so the 12,009 genuine Co2+ rows are untouched.

components.mapping_note: [CHEM-B12-01] cbl1 is Cob(I)alamin, the transient reduced Co(I) intracellular redox state of the cofactor -- it is not a dietary or medium B12 species. Cyanocobalamin (C63H88CoN14O14P) has no in_biggr BiGG id (b12 carries no formula and no InChIKey and is absent from BiGGr). adocbl (Adenosylcobalamin, C72H100CoN18O17P, ZIHHMGTYZOSFRC-QRVZQHAISA-N) is a real dietary/coenzyme B12 form present in BiGGr and is recorded as a declared proxy for the vitamer group, not as an exact identity.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
